blocks.text: Setting up the Canva desktop app on Mac

The Canva desktop app for macOS offers a dedicated space for your creative work. It requires macOS 12 or later and runs on both Apple Silicon and Intel chips. Download the installer from the official Canva website to get started. Once installed, log in to your account. You will find that the app behaves like the web version but keeps your designs in a separate Dock icon. This helps you keep your design work away from your browser tabs.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for your workflow

items: Press T to add a text box.
Press R to add a rectangle.
Press C to add a circle.
Press L to draw a line.
Use ⌘ + G to group selected elements.
Use ⌘ + D to duplicate your current selection.
Use ⌘ + Z to undo your last action.

blocks.text: Memorizing these keys turns hours of clicking into minutes of work. If you forget a shortcut, ask Lazur to point out the menu location for that action. Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item so you can find it instantly.
Managing layers and alignment in Canva

Layer management is a common struggle for many creators. When your design gets complex, use the Position menu. Click on Position in the top toolbar. Select the Layers tab to see every element on your canvas. You can drag items up or down to change their order. This is much faster than clicking on overlapping images and hoping you grab the right one.

Lazur acts as your personal assistant for the Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask where a specific tool is located. For example, if you cannot find the background remover, simply ask Lazur. It will point to the button on your screen. If you need to write a caption for your social media post, hold fn and dictate it directly into the Canva text box. You do not need to switch apps or copy and paste.
Common mistakes and how to avoid them

items: Not using the Layers panel for complex designs.
Manually resizing elements instead of using the Position > Arrange menu.
Forgetting to check the resolution before exporting.
Leaving unused elements on the pasteboard area of the canvas.
Skipping the use of templates for consistent brand identity.

blocks.text: Refining your social media design process

Consistency is vital for social media. Use the Brand Kit feature to store your fonts, colors, and logos. When you start a new design, apply your brand colors with one click. If you are working on a series of posts, duplicate your first page using ⌘ + D. This ensures all your posts have the same layout and feel. If the app slows down, check your internet connection or clear your cache in the app settings. If the interface is still stuck, use ⌘ + ⌥ + Esc to force quit the app and reopen it.

faq.question: Can I use Canva offline on my Mac?
faq.answer: The Canva desktop app is primarily web-based and requires an internet connection to access your designs and the asset library.

faq.question: How do I find the keyboard shortcuts in Canva?
faq.answer: You can press the forward slash key / on your keyboard to open the Quick Actions menu, which lists many commands and their shortcuts.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me in Canva?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points at the screen to help you find tools and guides you through steps so you can perform the actions yourself.
